chunks: Abu al-Abbas Muhammad ibn Ibrahim al-Mukatib (may God be pleased with him) narrated to us. He said: Abu Said al-Hasan ibn Ali al-Adawi narrated to us. He said: Al-Haytham ibn Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Al-Ma'mun narrated to us from his father al-Rashid, from al-Mahdi, from his father al-Mansur, from his father, from his grandfather, from Ibn Abbas, who said: The Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) said
to Ali (peace be upon him): You are my inheritor.

key_terms.رسول الله: The Messenger of God — title of Prophet Muhammad (SAWW)
key_terms.وارث: Inheritor, successor — refers to spiritual and temporal inheritance of prophetic knowledge and authority

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet Muhammad say to Ali about being his inheritor?
ai.summary: The Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) declared to Imam Ali (AS) that he is his inheritor. This statement, transmitted through a chain of Abbasid caliphs tracing back to the Prophet's cousin Ibn Abbas, affirms Ali's unique spiritual and temporal succession to the Prophet. In Shia tradition, this hadith is one of many establishing Ali's right to succeed the Prophet as the leader of the Muslim community.

en.bilal-muhammad: Abu’l `Abbas Muhammad b. Ibrahim al-Mukatib (ra) narrated to us. He said: Abu Sa`id al-Hasan b. `Ali al-`Adawi narrated to us. He said: Al-Haytham b. `Abdullah narrated to us. He said: Al-Ma’mun narrated to us from his father al-Rashid from al-Mahdi from his father al-Mansur from his father from his grandfather from Ibn `Abbas. He said: The Messenger of Allah (s) said
